Supermarket giant GroceryCo launches new payment app

GroceryCo, the national supermarket chain, has launched a new payment app for its 600 stores across the UK.

The app, which the company says was developed by an internal team of 200 engineers, lets shoppers scan and pay with their phones.

GroceryCo is listed on the London Stock Exchange and employs more than 90,000 people, so the launch is a product update rather than a startup story.
